The equipment covers suction units, anaesthesia workstations, patient and fluid warming, ventilators, infusion pumps, monitors, an X-ray unit, surgical tables and histology laboratory equipment.
what_they_want: Lot 1: portable electric suction units (battery/mains powered). Lot 2: anaesthesia workstation. Lot 3: blood and fluid warming systems. Lot 4: portable adult ventilator. Lot 5: syringe-type drug infusion pumps. Lot 6: nursing/treatment trolley. Lot 7: portable digital X-ray machine. Lot 8: LED light source and processor with camera head. Lot 9: neonatal vital signs monitor on a trolley base. Lot 10: vital signs monitors. Lot 11: portable surgical tables. Lot 12: patient warming devices with heating mattresses, (1) 150x50 cm and (2) 105x50 cm. Lot 13: automatic histology slide coverslipper. Lot 14: safety cabinet for storing histology specimens with a built-in air cleaning/recycling system. Lot 15: tissue embedding system. Lot 16: paraffin section flotation water baths with LED lighting. Lot 17: general surgery suction devices. No brands or model numbers are mentioned.

buyer_name: ΓΕΝΙΚΟ ΝΟΣΟΚΟΜΕΙΟ ΠΑΙΔΩΝ ΑΘΗΝΩΝ ΠΑΝΑΓΙΩΤΗ & ΑΓΛΑΪΑΣ ΚΥΡΙΑΚΟΥ
english_summary: The Penteli/Agia Sophia-area children's hospital "P. & A. Kyriakou" General Children's Hospital of Athens is procuring consumables for respiratory support and oxygen therapy. These include ventilator breathing circuits, CPAP/Miniflow masks and nasal prongs, and heated high-flow circuit sets. The items are compatible with specific ventilator and flow-therapy systems (SLE2000, Servo-i, Miniflow, Airvo/Airvo2, Optiflow).
what_they_want: Breathing and respiratory therapy consumables, including: breathing circuits for SLE2000 ventilators; infant circuits for Servo-i; paediatric/adult circuits for Servo-i ventilators; circuits for SLE ventilators; CPAP and Miniflow masks in Small, Medium and Large sizes; self-adhesive items for nasal prongs; oxygen therapy goggles/glasses; foam nose-protection pads; headgear/caps for fixation; circuits with Medium and Large masks; special Miniflow valves; nasal prongs for Miniflow; nasal prongs for oxygen therapy (including for Airvo); heated circuit sets for Optiflow and Airvo2; and a circuit for administering volatile gases (e.g. anaesthetic or inhaled agents). Brands/models mentioned: SLE2000, Servo-i, SLE, Miniflow, Airvo, Airvo2, Optiflow. Quantities are not stated.

buyer_name: SPITALUL DE ORTOPEDIE SI TRAUMATOLOGIE AZUGA
english_summary: Spitalul de Ortopedie si Traumatologie Azuga (Romania) is tendering for the supply of a range of medical equipment, divided into 12 lots. The lots cover an orthopaedic surgical motor system, ICU beds, a ventilator, infusion and feeding pumps, ECG machines, defibrillators, an EEG system, patient and fluid warming systems, and an ultraportable ultrasound scanner. Full details are in the Technical Specifications (Caiet de sarcini), which are referenced but not included in this notice.
what_they_want: Lot 1: 1 complete surgical motor system for use as an orthopaedic motor. Lot 2: 5 intensive care beds with built-in scale and backrest. Lot 3: 1 mechanical ventilator. Lot 4: 2 syringe pumps (injectomat). Lot 5: 2 infusion pumps (infuzomat). Lot 6: 2 enteral feeding pumps (nutripump). Lot 7: ECG devices, with two items bid and evaluated separately: (1) 4 portable ECG units and (2) 1 12-channel ECG unit. Lot 8: defibrillators, bid as a single package of 2 manual defibrillators with external pacemaker, 2 semi-automatic defibrillators and 2 manual defibrillators; bidding for a single item alone is not accepted. Lot 9 (the lot number is not shown in the text): 1 complete EEG system for acquisition, recording, review and analysis of EEG signals, including the active array, workstation, software, EEG headset system and all accessories needed for full operation. Lot 10: 2 complete external patient warming systems, each with a warm-air heating unit, flexible hose, mobile stand, compatible disposable blankets and all required accessories and cables; functionally equivalent solutions are accepted with technical justification. Lot 11: 1 controlled warming system for infusion fluids, blood products and, only where authorised and documented for the device, parenteral and/or enteral nutrition products. Lot 12: 1 ultraportable multifunctional ultrasound scanner for echocardiography, abdominal, FAST, obstetric, gynaecological, lung and soft-tissue imaging. It comes with 3 transducers (cardiac/sector, abdominal/convex, linear for soft tissue), a compatible display device and image acquisition, storage, measurement and review software. No brands or model numbers are mentioned.
